must.title: Cache Reliability
must.description: Ensure caching operations are reliable and do not introduce system instability.
must.metric: Cache operations have a failure rate of less than 1%.
acceptance_criteria: Cache reliability tests show less than 1% failure rate.
System stability is maintained during cache operations.
NFR-002 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
must.verification: Run reliability tests with simulated cache failures.

should.title: Performance Improvement
should.description: Achieve a significant reduction in execution time for cached methods.
should.metric: Execution time reduced by at least 30% for cached methods.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests confirm a 30% reduction in execution time.
Cache hit rates meet or exceed 80%.
NFR-001 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
should.verification: Conduct performance benchmarking before and after caching implementation.

should.title: Observability of Caching
should.description: Implement observability for caching operations to facilitate monitoring and debugging.
should.metric: 100% of caching operations are logged with sufficient detail.
acceptance_criteria: Logs capture all cache read/write operations.
Logs include details necessary for debugging cache issues.
NFR-003 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
should.verification: Review logs during test runs to ensure completeness and detail.

should.title: Scalability of Caching Solution
should.description: Ensure the caching solution can scale with increased load.
should.metric: Caching solution supports a 2x increase in load without degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Load tests show no degradation with 2x expected peak load.
Cache performance metrics remain stable under increased load.
NFR-004 criterion 3 is measurable and testable.
should.verification: Conduct load testing with 2x expected peak load.
